name: Missing Episode Marker
description: Checks every series Sonarr manages for monitored episodes without a file and burns a configurable "missing episodes" banner into the series and season posters, so every client (including Swiftfin, Infuse and TV apps) shows it. Supports a grace period for ongoing shows, special-episode rules, per-series overrides and anime filler handling.
overview: Marks TV shows and seasons that are missing episodes, using Sonarr.

versions.changelog: New shows are marked as soon as their poster arrives (Jellyfin downloads artwork after the scan), and after a metadata refresh. New option (on): fetch a new poster for shows whose poster is missing or a video frame. New option (off): the same for movies. The report shows when a poster is still on its way.
Saving settings that affect detection, rules or appearance now starts a new check automatically, so posters follow the new settings right away. Clearer plugin image.

Markers come back within seconds when Jellyfin replaces a poster, and a series is rechecked as soon as episodes are added or removed. Settings page reorganized into tabs with search, multi-select rules, a specials picker and help texts. Grace period in days/weeks/months/years, schedule setting, progress bar with time estimate, optional menu entry, poster status in the report, and a plugin image.
